confidence_method: Separate exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bounds
completion_interpretation: Official full-time report publication timestamp is an upper bound on completion, never an exact final-whistle claim. Earliest plausible CET/CEST original and latest plausible report timezone widen the interval.
excluded_source: All 144 ESPN keyEvents wallclock histories are frozen but unused as completion evidence; many are bulk update times. ESPN supplies only final fixture identity, league-phase classification and suspension flags.
limitations: One completed season; no pooling with old group format or another competition.
Separate marginal bounds are not a joint 95% guarantee.
Binomial interval assumes an exchangeable population; correlated shocks and future regime shifts are not guaranteed bounded.
Source timestamps and pre-event provenance rely on official UEFA publication metadata, not an external timestamp authority.
No realized EV, executable depth, fee, fill-quality or profit inference.
